name: roast-my-design-system
description: Roast your repo's design system with real data: a 0-100 health score, the receipts behind it (every colour, spacing value, duplicated component and inline style) and the first fixes ranked by payoff. The skill runs the published roast-my-design-system scanner from npm: deterministic, read-only, benchmarked against 119 public repos and 10 reputable design systems, one shareable light/dark HTML report. It can also write the agent rules file that keeps AI-written UI on-system.

interface.longDescription: Your AI can write the UI. This makes sure it writes your UI. Ask for a roast and the skill runs the published roast-my-design-system scanner on the current repo: a deterministic, read-only scan that counts everything that betrays a design system, from colours and their near-identical twins to greys, off-scale spacing, duplicated and never-imported components, inline styles and arbitrary Tailwind values. It scores the repo 0-100 against a benchmark of 119 public repos and 10 reputable design systems, writes a shareable light/dark HTML report with the receipts and the first fixes ranked by payoff, and can write the agent rules file that keeps AI-written UI on-system. Nothing leaves your machine.
